references.text: The previous verse where Gaal first sees the people coming down from the mountains, and Zebul dismisses his observation
Mentions the oak of Meonenim (אֵלוֹן מְעוֹנְנִים) where Abimelech was crowned king
Abram passed through the land to the place at Shechem, to the oak of Moreh, which may be the same holy site
Mentions the oaks of Moreh in the same geographical area near Shechem
Uses the expression 'navel of the earth' (טַבּוּר הָאָרֶץ) to describe a central point
Earlier verses where the men of Shechem lie in ambush on the mountains, the same area Gaal now observes
